python3 - <<'PY'
import json, glob
files=[
('.tmp/inspect_play.json','after one-shot play'),
('.tmp/inspect_pause.json','after one-shot pause'),
('.tmp/inspect_resume.json','after one-shot resume'),
('.tmp/inspect_next.json','after one-shot next'),
('.tmp/inspect_queue_play.json','after queue play'),
('.tmp/inspect_queue_pause.json','after queue pause'),
('.tmp/inspect_queue_resume.json','after queue resume'),
('.tmp/inspect_queue_next.json','after queue next (skip)'),
('.tmp/inspect_queue_seek2.json','after queue seek (fast-forward)')
]
for path,label in files:
    try:
        d=json.load(open(path))
    except Exception as e:
        print(label, 'missing', e)
        continue
    pb=d.get('playback',{})
    info=pb.get('songInfo')
    song_path=info.get('path') if isinstance(info,dict) else None
    pos=info.get('position') if isinstance(info,dict) else None
    dur=info.get('duration') if isinstance(info,dict) else None
    print(label)
    print('  isPlaying:',pb.get('isPlaying'))
    print('  currentIndex:',pb.get('currentIndex'))
    print('  song:',song_path)
    print('  position/duration(ms):',pos,dur)
PY
